headline: Unit 2 of the Cernavodă Nuclear Power Plant in Romania Could Be Shut Down Thursday, August 13. Currently, the Republic of Moldova Imports About 40% of Its Electricity from Romania
summary: Nuclearelectrica said Unit 2 of the Cernavoda plant could be shut down on the morning of August 13. Moldova currently imports about 40% of its electricity from Romania.
why: Nuclearelectrica is Romania's nuclear power producer, and outages at Cernavoda affect regional power supply and prices.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Unitatea 2 a centralei nuclearoelectrice de la Cernavodă, din România, ar putea fi oprită joi, 13 august. În prezent, R. Moldova importă aproximativ 40% din energia electrică din România
